summary: Beyond the Past is an educational 3D space exploration game where players become astronauts, explore different locations in space, discover abandoned NASA equipment, rebuild it, and complete scientific challenges to learn about its importance in space exploration.
details: 1. Our project, Abandoned but Not Forgotten, is a 3D educational game where players explore the Moon, Mars, and asteroid Eros to recover five historic NASA instruments. Players explore, rebuild missing parts, complete science challenges, and unlock mission stories. 2. The game makes learning interactive and enjoyable. It helps players discover scientific facts, understand how space instruments work, and develop problem-solving skills. 3. Our goal is to preserve the history of space exploration, raise awareness about forgotten missions, and inspire interest in science and technology. 4. We used Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js to develop the game, its 3D graphics, animations, and physics. 5. Our creativity comes from turning forgotten NASA missions into interactive adventures. We considered scientific accuracy, realistic environments, graphics, physics, gameplay, accessibility, and educational value. During development, we also had to modify some graphics and physics to improve the gaming experience.
